title: Add a database migration (platform, reference or tenant)
caption: packages/db/README.md 'Files'; conventions §9. Baselines are byte copies of docs/velexis-sdk/db/*.sql and are never edited; neither is any merged file.

steps.title: Write the file
steps.body: Next number in the right folder: `platform/backend/migrations/platform/0005_<name>.sql`, `…/reference/`, or `ota/backend/migrations/tenant/0006_<name>.sql`. First line `-- velexis:phase expand|migrate|contract`, then `-- <description>`. No BEGIN/COMMIT. `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` needs `-- velexis:no-transaction` and `IF NOT EXISTS`.

steps.title: Grants (platform tables the OTA reads)
steps.body: Edit `R__ota_read_access.sql` (GRANT/REVOKE/COMMENT ON only) — it may be edited, it re-applies when its SHA-256 changes. Tenant tables need no GRANT: default privileges cover them.
steps.expect: `velexis_ota_app` can SELECT the new platform table; nothing else.

steps.title: Test and commit
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/db test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:int` for the backend that uses it. Commit the migration and the generated files together.
steps.expect: CI's 'generated files up to date' step passes.
